label: Data accuracy, completeness & currency
definition: Data quality discussed as uncertain input; not a quantitative UQ claim.

label: Geometry, morphology & design
definition: Building geometry, design or morphology variability/error.

label: Classification & prediction error
definition: Prediction, classification or inferred-event accuracy/error explicitly recorded.

label: Material intensity & stock parameters
definition: Variation/ranges in material intensity, composition or material-stock parameters.

label: Lifetime, turnover & event timing
definition: Service lives, turnover, event dates or analysis horizons; distinct from elapsed computing time.

label: Model form & upscaling assumptions
definition: Model-family, representation or upscaling choice; not automatically an epistemic classification.

label: Future scenarios & policy assumptions
definition: Alternative futures or policy assumptions; scenarios are not assigned probabilities here.

label: Recovery share, reuse & quality
definition: Recoverability, reuse feasibility or material quality in circular routing.

label: Environmental factors & processes
definition: Emission factors, environmental parameters or carbonation process parameters.

label: Hazard & damage states
definition: Seismic hazard, damage or loss in complementary consequence studies.

label: Qualitative quality / uncertainty assessment
definition: Qualitative input-quality or uncertainty assessment.

label: Prediction-error / validation diagnostics
definition: Model accuracy, residual/error scores or predictive validation; not propagated UQ by default.

label: Ranges / probability-distribution representation
definition: Explicit range or distribution representation; does not by itself establish transfer.

label: Monte Carlo / probabilistic sampling
definition: Monte Carlo or parameter sampling recorded; no implication that all inputs are jointly propagated.

label: Bootstrap for uncertainty outputs
definition: Resampling linked to output uncertainty; ML training-data augmentation is excluded.

label: Sensitivity / representation comparison
definition: Input, model-family, geometry or importance comparisons; not necessarily probabilistic.

label: Scenario comparison
definition: Alternative-future or policy scenario evaluation.

label: Conditional consequence distributions
definition: Conditional mapping from damage to interventions/consequences.

label: Proxy conversion & aggregation
definition: Expected-loss proxy transformed to expected environmental consequences.

label: Review synthesis
definition: Secondary methodological synthesis; no primary propagation experiment.
